about.bio_intro: I'm a Software Engineer in Next.js & TypeScript, building engaging web applications and exploring the frontiers of IoT & robotics. I graduated with a Bachelor of Industrial Technology in Information Technology from King Mongkut's University of Technology North Bangkok (Prachinburi Campus).
about.bio_edu_desc: Bachelor of Industrial Technology in Information Technology, King Mongkut's University of Technology North Bangkok (Prachinburi Campus).
